title: spend-reservations.jsonl - one line of a run's reservation record
description: runs/<id>/spend-reservations.jsonl, appended by src/spend-reservations.js: one JSON object per line, each written whole with one write and fsynced. A 'reserved' line is the worst case of a paid call, written BEFORE the request is sent; a 'settled' line follows when the call returns or throws. A reserved line with no settled line is a call that was in flight when the process ended: it stays charged at its worst case in a resume's cap, council --spend and the spend report. A last line with no newline is a torn write and is ignored. The file carries amounts, stage labels and provider/model only, never task text or run content. Not tamper-evident: whoever can write the run folder can edit it. This schema describes one line.

id.description: r1, r2, ... per run folder; a resume continues after the ones already in the file.

usd.description: reserved: the call's worst case. settled: what it cost, or null when it is not known.
